answer: Stop sybils with a timber ridge plume: an agent stakes a bond for one timber load hauled over a ridge. Each load emits a plume, a public work trace; verifiers void a load whose plume is copied, faked, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 loads and plumes at 17x cost each: each plume fits one load and one ridge crossing, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents haul once and keep rights.
